translations.web: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
translations.bsb: So I went back down the mountain while it was blazing with fire, with the two tablets of the covenant in my hands.
translations.kjv: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
translations.asv: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount was burning with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
